subject: Implement RelationshipService for Layer 2 database operations
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/database/relationships.py` with async service methods for foreign key discovery and BFS join path finding.

Methods to implement:
- `async def get_foreign_keys(pool, table_name, schema_name) -> ForeignKeysOutput`
  - Queries `SYS.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS` for both outgoing and incoming FKs
  - Returns separate lists for outgoing (this table references others) and incoming (others reference this table)
  - Includes constraint name, source/target schema, table, columns, delete rule
- `async def find_join_path(pool, from_table, to_table, from_schema, to_schema, max_depth) -> FindJoinPathOutput`
  - Loads all FK relationships in relevant schemas
  - Builds bidirectional adjacency graph
  - BFS traversal from source to target table
  - Returns all paths up to `max_depth` (1-6, default 4), sorted by length
  - Generates executable SQL JOIN clause for each path

All methods use `asyncio.to_thread()` for hdbcli calls.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `get_foreign_keys` returns both outgoing and incoming FKs with full metadata
- [ ] `find_join_path` uses BFS to find all paths within max_depth
- [ ] Paths sorted by length (shortest first)
- [ ] SQL JOIN examples generated for each discovered path
- [ ] Bidirectional graph handles FKs in both directions

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Row store table: returns empty results with note about HANA FK limitation
- [ ] No FKs on table: returns empty lists with informative note
- [ ] No path exists: returns PATH_NOT_FOUND with suggestion about row store
- [ ] Multiple paths of same length: all returned
- [ ] Cross-schema paths: fully qualified table names in SQL examples

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Table not found: returns TABLE_NOT_FOUND error with fuzzy suggestions
- [ ] max_depth exceeded: returns partial results with note

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: FK retrieval with mocked referential constraints data
• Unit: BFS pathfinding with various graph topologies
• Unit: SQL JOIN generation for multi-hop paths
• Unit: Bidirectional edge handling
• Unit: Cross-schema path resolution

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.2, 9.2, 13.2
